mainEntity.name: Does my company need a separate tax return?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A company lodges its own tax return, separate from the directors' personal returns. The matched accountant prepares the financial statements, lodges the company return, and manages franking credits and imputation. Directors still lodge their own individual returns.

mainEntity.name: What is Payday Super and when does it start?

acceptedAnswer.text: From 1 July 2026, under 'Payday Super', employers must pay super guarantee contributions alongside each payday — with contributions required to reach the employee's fund within 7 business days. The matched accountant ensures your payroll system is ready and compliant, so you avoid director penalty notices for late super.

mainEntity.name: Can an accountant help with small business CGT concessions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The 15-year exemption, 50% active asset reduction, retirement exemption and small business roll-over can significantly reduce CGT on selling a business asset. The matched accountant assesses eligibility, structures the sale, and lodges the concessions correctly.

mainEntity.name: How much does a company accountant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A company or trust tax return typically costs $500–$1,500 depending on entity count, complexity and the state of the books. Ongoing accounting is usually $400–$1,000 per month. The matched accountant gives you a clear quote. The matching itself is free.

mainEntity.name: Can an accountant handle my ASIC annual review?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched accountant manages ASIC annual review obligations, company updates, and ensures your corporate records stay compliant — avoiding late fees and director penalties for unresolved ASIC lodgements.

mainEntity.name: Can a company accountant help with cash-flow forecasting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many matched firms offer cash-flow forecasting, budgeting and management reporting alongside compliance. Tell us in the questionnaire whether you want forward-looking advisory as well as returns and BAS, and we will match you with a firm that offers both.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched company accountant contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your business.

mainEntity.name: Can an accountant help if my company is behind on lodgements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tell us in the questionnaire that your company has overdue returns or BAS. The matched accountant works through the backlog, brings your lodgements current, and requests penalty remission where mitigating circumstances apply.
